integrity: A complete analytic all-radius proof is given in RESULT.md. verify.py supplies independent exact-rational finite checks and conservative numerical inequality samples; no finite test is asserted to prove the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-start discrete simple random walks on finite undirected unit-conductance graphs; constructive nonoptimal size \(K=\max\{100,4r+10\}\). Does not resolve worst-start insertion effects or minimal witness order. Uses the published cut-vertex transfer identity, separately reconstructed. Historical priority of an unindexed equivalent cannot be excluded.
title: Equal-order nonlocality for edge-insertion changes of random-walk cover time
